content.comment_body: I am unable to find [article_no] controller in the catalog of [product_name] [version_no]. I want to connect to the controller using a USB cable to transfer the program from the controller to my PC. My second question is whether I need to put the controller in stop mode to upload the program. Is it possible to upload the program while the controller is running? I would prefer not to shut down the machine currently controlled by the device.

You might be unable to select the correct interface for the USB cable. Does the interface selection display a COM port at all? Try taking a screenshot for reference. You can only transmit changes to the program when the controller is in STOP mode. Program changes during operation are not possible.

There is a compressor unit in our plant managed by the [article_no] controller, and I want to back up the logic stored in that controller. I don’t intend to modify anything—just to create a backup so that if the controller fails, I can quickly install a new one. By the way, I have a licensed [product_name] [version_no] and a USB cable.
Did you install the drivers for your USB cable? What type of USB cable are you using? Is it an original from [company_name] or a third-party option?
I'm facing a similar issue. Can someone help us?

In [product_name] [version_no], you must first select the correct controller version. There’s a selection box on the lower right side of the workspace on your PC. When you download or upload the program, be sure to choose the appropriate interface; for the [article_no], it’s the CABLE. Keep in mind, the controller will stop automatically during upload or download, but it may not always restart itself afterward. Make sure your device is running after completing these actions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report challenges locating and accessing the [article_no] controller within the [product_name] [version_no] hardware catalog, particularly when working with a USB cable. Main issues involve backing up the existing logic in the controller and clarifying requirements such as needing STOP mode for upload/download actions. Uncertainty about selecting the correct version and configuring interfaces is affecting workflow confidence and smooth operation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily locate the [article_no] controller in the software catalog, establish USB connectivity, and back up or upload programs without stopping machine operations.
